name: 71635 · Crossett, AR
findings: ZIP 71635 (Crossett) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71635 (Crossett) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
